---
name: Add product
description: Add one app or software product to js/products.js.
---

Add exactly one app object to `js/products.js` using the details I provide. Include a unique kebab-case `id`, `name`, `category`, `description`, Philippine-peso `price`, `demoUrl`, `demoNote`, `features`, `screenshots`, `terms`, and `paymentDetails`, following the existing product shape.

Use only supplied facts. Keep missing values as clearly marked editable placeholders; do not invent capabilities, prices, demo limits, or licensing terms. Screenshot sources must be owned/local paths, never remote marketplace images. Preserve the existing contact-first Buy flow and formatting. Do not change page rendering or other product entries.
